messages:
Tom CSM: Quick check-in — Acme account health. Yesterday's canary rolled v2.2 at ~23:10 UTC and we saw an odd adoption/regen pattern. Posting numbers and context below.

Maria CS: FYI usage snapshot: tokens/day 1.2M -> 1.05M (-12%). New model share v2.2 ~48%, v2.1 ~50%. Fallbacks to baseline (v2.0) jumped 3.8% -> 9.4% after canary. Cost/1k tokens up ~18% due to retries.

Aj Dev: Seeing a lot of regenerations in the logs, many tied to client-side retries after timeouts. Example log line: 

```
2023-11-22T23:11:02Z request_id=xyz model=v2.2 reason=timeout regen=true latency=1450ms
```

Sara Ops: Latency SLO breaches line up with an AZ blip between 23:05-23:20 UTC. P50 increased from ~120ms -> ~490ms; P95 from ~380ms -> ~1.2s.

deploy-bot: deploy 2023-11-22T23:09:58Z user=eng-release tag=v2.2-canary

Tom CSM: Customer submitted ticket #3421 — said responses came back empty sometimes and retries returned different outputs. They're concerned about determinism.

Maria CS: Ran quick evals on our side: slight quality dip on a subset of summarization prompts but nothing catastrophic. The pattern looks more like regen loops than model hallucination.

Aj Dev: Hypothesis: v2.2 increases average decode steps for certain prompts which pushes end-to-end latency over client timeouts, triggering retries and extra token generation. Also seeing less efficient KV cache behavior for that variant on some shard combos.

Sara Ops: Proposal — reduce canary to 10% and enable automatic fallback to v2.1 while we investigate. That should reduce regen volume and cost.

Tom CSM: Agreed. Action items:
- Aj: apply temporary rollout policy (10% canary + fallback to v2.1) — ETA 30m
- Sara: correlate AZ errors + network egress, open infra escal if needed — ETA 1h
- Maria: draft customer-facing note and offer quick sync — ETA 1h

Aj Dev: I'm applying the rollout change now. Patch (short):

```
rollout_percent: 10
fallback_model: v2.1
regen_protection: true
```

deploy-bot: rollout updated by Aj Dev at 2023-11-22T23:37:40Z

Tom CSM: Thanks — we'll watch fallback rate and regen volume. If the customer escalates we may rollback fully. Re-check in next weekly ops if stable.

Sara Ops: Created ops ticket OPS-7898 to track infra correlation and follow-up.

Maria CS: I'll send an interim update to Acme summarizing mitigation and offering a call.

Tom CSM: Please post any new numbers in-thread. :thumbsup:
